[B3] < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , 'knownDevice' : false , ... > < deviceB | 'key' : Key , ... > $ UserX 'discover' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , 'knownDevice' : true , ... > < deviceB | 'key' : Key , ... > $ deviceB 'bind' cloudA | (Key) .
[B3] < deviceB | 'key' : Key , 'owner' : nils , ... > < cloudA | UserY : ('accountKey' : Key , ...) , ... > $ deviceB 'bind' cloudA | (Key)
=> < deviceB | 'key' : Key , 'owner' : UserY , ... > < cloudA | UserY : ('accountKey' : Key , ...) , ... > .
[B4] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > < deviceB | ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > < deviceB | ... > .
[B5] < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
